item.title: Review: Reanimal (PS5) - First-Rate Terrors Thrive in This Haunting Spectacle - Push Square
item.description: By improving upon its work from the Little Nightmares series, Tarsier Studios has crafted its greatest horror game yet. Reanimal is an impressive, smooth mix of action, platforming, and top-of-the-line presentation. Its a very gripping and intense experience, both in solo play and co-op.

item.title: Romeo Is A Dead Man Review (PS5) Romeo Is a Great Man - PSU
item.description: PSU: "Romeo Is a Dead Man is yet another belter from a director who marches to the beat of his own drum. It's unapologetically weird, well-conceived and just downright fun to play, and that's all I could really ask for. Every small detail forms a tapestry that can't really be described, only experienced with your own eyes. Where every design idiosyncracy might not land, it doesn't apologise for that. Why should it?"

item.title: Review: Romeo Is a Dead Man (PS5) - Absurd, Entertaining, and Tedious All at Once - PS
item.description: Just as enjoyable as it is frustrating, Romeo Is a Dead Man is an incredibly uneven experience. Youll love it one minute and hate it the next. Persevere with its more annoying elements, and youll discover a unique and entertaining hack and slasher at the end of it all. It just takes a lot of effort and restraint to get there.

item.title: PS5 vs Xbox Series Sales Comparison - December 2025
item.description: December 2025 is the 62nd month the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S has been available for. In the latest month, the gap grew in favor of the PlayStation 5 when compared to the aligned launch of the Xbox Series X|S by 2.94 million units. In the last 12 months, the PlayStation 5 has outsold the Xbox Series X|S by 14.85 million units. The PlayStation 5 is currently ahead by 55.27 million units.

item.title: No Man's Sky - Remnant Update Trailer
item.description: In Remnant, the latest free update for No Man's Sky downloadable today, PlayStation players get their hands on the Gravitino Coil, a gravity gun module for their multi-tool. The Gravitino Coil is a powerful new module for your multi-tool which enables you to draw large weighty objects towards you from afar and relocate them, fling them, or carry them to your (newly customisable) Colossus exocraft where they can be loaded up, transported across the planet and processed for high reward.

item.title: Highguard Developer Wildlight Entertainment Reportedly Lays Off 'Most Of The Team'
item.description: In Graner's post, he says this layoff "really stings as there was a lot of unreleased content I was really looking forward to that I and others designed for Highguard." If we take his words literally, it sounds like that content might never be released, which would be shocking but not unprecedented in this industry, which has been under constant disruption due to layoffs.
